_comment: Contact. Address and social marks left, enquiry form right. The form has no backend and wants none: SEND composes a mailto: to the address below and hands it to the visitor's own mail client. The old page ran Wix's form app, which posted to Wix and forwarded to an address held in the Wix account; none of that survives the migration, and nothing replaces it.
_socials_note: Taken verbatim from the archived Wix contact page. Note that the Instagram handle there is @jujuhung, not the @juju.hung this file used to carry — the old one was wrong.

form._mailto_note: SEND goes to the address in "email" above. assets/js/contact.js builds the subject from the enquiry type and the sender's name and puts the message in the body; with JavaScript off the form posts to the same address as plain text. Nothing is stored and nothing is sent without the visitor pressing send in their own mail client, so there is no spam surface and no honeypot.

_dropped: The redesign drops the old Studio / Representation / Commissions rows — the reference design has only the address and the marks. Studio locations (Taipei · New York) and the pointer to /commission/ now live nowhere on the site; restore them here as a .meta block under the socials if that turns out to matter.
